name: Createscape Town～Nyanzou&Kumakichi: Escape Game～
description:
Nyanzou is always making a ruckus. But it looks like he’s quietly drawing today for a change.
He’s writing down all kinds of things he’s always dreamed of like, “3 Meals, Nap Time, Snacks Included” and “No Homework”. What in the world is he up to?

This time, it’s an escape game where you can create your own town!
Try to escape by building a town while solving puzzles.
